agent_priors_used: GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): long-lived research agents over-exploit their deepest local thread (local attractor / sunk-cost) and under-invest in single shared prerequisites; a Global Director should prefer removing one shared blocker once over letting each lane re-discover the same absence.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose baselines sit at the ceiling has zero dynamic range and cannot detect a treatment effect even if the treatment is good - ceiling baselines are a null instrument, not weak evidence.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a treatment must be shown live and separable from its comparator before an expensive multi-arm benchmark is funded; arm-differentiation certificates belong upstream of economics runs.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a small CPU-quantized local model used as the flagship same-model endpoint risks measuring model capability rather than architecture; prompt specification and model ability are separate failure modes and must be separated experimentally before either is blamed.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): orchestration/control-plane defects recur as a class (unsatisfiable freeze gates, missing pre-freeze certificates), so they should be fixed at the control plane rather than re-litigated per experiment.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): mechanisms and levels of description should be judged by decision value, not by whether they are novel; continuing a mature thread is correct when the next result can still change an important architecture or product decision.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (pre2 artifact 4.697, sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) reported 3/3 unseen compositions versus 0/3 weak baselines but only with keyword/oracle dependence - the same confound class (joint authorship / oracle assistance) this experiment removes. P2-MIND2WEB (archived Codex section 1) found retrieval matches 47/176 versus exact human routes 6/176, supporting a retrieve-and-bind mechanism rather than exact-route replay. This experiment materially improves on both by independently authoring goals, screening contamination against every registry intent, and proving the reference arm distinct from the candidate. Not a pointless rerun: the bounded 45/52 vs 33/52 Research 2.0 result was never tested without the joint-authorship confound, and the design-contract v2 controls make the accept and reject regions arithmetically reachable.
allocation.question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal texts are authored by a process that never sees the mechanism intent strings, with a preregistered contamination screen measuring every goal's overlap against EVERY intent in the registry, a preregistered authoring-provenance record, a reference arm provably distinct from the candidate, and positive/null/dynamic-range controls that are each arithmetically able to fail and are live-verified before freeze: does max-cosine-similarity selection over intent embeddings still bind the correct mechanism on goals never seen at authoring time, and by how much does it exceed a token-overlap null on those same independently authored goals - i.e., does the bounded 45/52 versus 33/52 advantage (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136,0.3509]) survive removal of the joint-authorship confound, or was it an artifact of intents and goal templates being authored in the same execute-time file by the same agent that reported the numbers?
allocation.rationale: Graph's dominant recent claim is C-FRESHNESS (7 of last 10, tunnel flag), but the lane's own last verdict decisively PARKED the four-anchor Part II route: the D1V population is single-anchor and transport-coupled, time-stable across two capture dates, and the anchor-clustered false-accept differential cannot be made non-degenerate on this substrate. Re-running those anchors is exactly the repetition the audit forbids. The in-flight PREFREEZE pivot to C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is strategically correct because (i) it is a genuinely different objective, (ii) all three prior C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packets died on control-plane/design defects (unsatisfiable V9 code-hash gate, tautological reference arm, inert controls) rather than on science, so a design-contract v2 test with live-verified controls can actually decide the claim, and (iii) goal-to-mechanism resolution without internal ids is a product-critical capability sitting directly beside the B1 carrier install, since the external agent supplies a natural-language goal. This is a mild, explicit tension with the audit's 'keep Graph on freshness/safety' note; I accept it because no ready non-four-anchor freshness test exists while this clean capability test is ready. This is not a local-attractor continuation: it leaves the C-FRESHNESS thread rather than extending it.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's center of gravity remains unproven: no accepted packet establishes a net end-to-end cost reduction per successful, partially novel Web task for a real external agent under the same model/tools/budget, and 255 of 434 canonical packets are REVISE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID (26.0% MEASUREMENT_INVALID). The Program Audit Global (2026-10-10) isolates three hard blockers - B1 no promoted parameterized carrier in src/spider/kernel.py (distill_parameterized absent, literal distill candidate confidence 0.5 < 0.8 threshold), B2 benchmark degeneracy (cold and retrieval both pinned at the 1.0 success ceiling on the deterministic credential-free REST class), B3 unresolved agent capability (0/5 on tested 3B/7B endpoints under an underspecified prompt) - and the system-prompt readiness rule forbids funding the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm benchmark until ALL THREE conditions hold. Reading the whole machine snapshot rather than local continuity: every scientific lane now has in-flight work, and the in-flight portfolio already concentrates on exactly those blockers (Product -> B1 carrier promotion; Runtime -> B2 non-degenerate task bank; Intel -> B3 minimal endpoint capability) with Graph, Physics and Frontier as supporting programs. Nothing in the accepted Codex since the last decision invalidates that arrangement: the last graph packet parked the four-anchor C-FRESHNESS Part II route, the frontier v1 discovery freeze was a BLOCKED design defect (empty sampling frame) rather than a substrate negative, and the physics barrier question is already FROZEN and must complete under its frozen design. A cognitive reset was performed for every lane ('if this lane met today's Codex with no inherited next_question, what would it investigate?'); in each case the answer converges on the same blocker-removal or a directly adjacent decision-relevant question, so I am not pivoting for novelty's sake. I am also refusing two temptations explicitly: (a) no new expansion of C-WEB-DYNAMICS / physics cosmology while the product thesis is untested - physics continues only on the frozen barrier-stationarity timescale program that has direct dead-end-policy decision value; (b) no repeat of the parked four D1V freshness anchors. The one mild tension with the audit's 'keep Graph on freshness/safety' guidance is deliberate: the parked route leaves no ready non-four-anchor freshness test, whereas the active C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE confound-removal is a clean, cheap, product-critical capability test (NL goal -> applicable mechanism without internal ids) sitting directly beside the B1 carrier install. Recurring control-plane measurement invalids (freeze cannot hash code; V9 unsatisfiable; absent pre-freeze certificates) are treated as one prerequisite to repair once via the design-contract v2 protocol rather than a reason to buy another cycle in any lane.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Research Scout was in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (model unavailable, rc=124): its scout_brief.json carried empty spider_evidence and external_directional_context, its candidate_directions were fallback echoes of the existing parent handoffs, and its stalled_or_idle_lanes were generic PREFREEZE entries rather than a real liveness diagnosis. It therefore added no external reconnaissance and did not change any allocation; every lane decision below was made from the machine snapshot, codex/claim_state effective statuses, research/claims/registry.json and the Program Audit Global. The only lasting effect of the degradation is negative: because no external competitor/benchmark context arrived, I did not create a new Intel reconnaissance mandate this cycle beyond the in-flight capability probe; if the B3 probe closes negatively (local 3B/7B models cannot complete the minimal task even with a proper goal/schema system prompt), a dedicated credential-free endpoint and external-baseline survey becomes justified and should be commissioned then.

inherited_next_question: Given that the transport-value coupling is now confirmed time-stable across two independent capture dates (M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY=UNCHANGED on all four anchors) and that the anchor-clustered bootstrap is certified capable of non-degenerate bounds (GATE F PASS), can a value-only-rotation (D1V) population spanning >=2 credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors be constructed -- either by admitting a materially different anchor population whose transport validators (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url) are provably independent of the rotating value, or by an instrument redesign that decouples body-derived validators and token-bearing final_urls from value rotation -- such that M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 and the anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V) is non-degenerate, thereby licensing INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED (CH-PRECOND-BINDING necessary) or INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND (value-aware channel deletable); or, if no such population/redesign is constructible on the credential-free GET-only substrate, should the four-anchor Part II route be PARKed and C-FRESHNESS redirected to a materially different objective (e.g., a guard false-accept/calibration measurement on a broader anchor population, or a different freshness sub-mechanism)?
